title: Art. 6.46 — Annex 9 - Facilitation, Chapter 6 - International Airports - Facilities and Services for Traffic, E. Unruly passengers, 6.46
content:
Each Contracting State shall take measures to ensure that relevant personnel are provided training to identify and manage unruly passenger situations.

Note. Guidance material on the legal aspects of unruly/disruptive passengers can be found in the Manual on the Legal Aspects of Unruly and Disruptive Passengers (Doc 10117).
